## Initial data prep

```{r}
ind_sector_data <- data_acs %>%
  filter(
    HISPAN == 2 | HISPAND == 200 | ANCESTR1 == 261, 
    AGE >= 16, 
    EMPSTAT == 1
  ) %>% 
  mutate(ind_sector = case_when(
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 0170  & IND <= 0290)  ~ "01. Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing & Hunting",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 0370  & IND <= 0490)  ~ "02. Mining, Quarrying, & Oil/Gas Extraction",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 0570  & IND <= 0690)  ~ "03. Utilities",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND == 0770)                ~ "04. Construction",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 1070 & IND <= 3990) ~ "05. Manufacturing",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 4070 & IND <= 4590) ~ "06. Wholesale Trade",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 4670 & IND <= 5791) ~ "07. Retail Trade",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 6070 & IND <= 6390) ~ "08. Transportation & Warehousing",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 6470 & IND <= 6695) ~ "09. Information",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 6870 & IND <= 6992) ~ "10. Finance & Insurance",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 7070 & IND <= 7190) ~ "11. Real Estate & Rental/Leasing",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 7270 & IND <= 7490) ~ "12. Professional, Scientific, & Tech Services",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 7570 & IND <= 7790) ~ "13. Administrative, Support, & Waste Mgmt",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 7860 & IND <= 7890) ~ "14. Educational Services",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 7970 & IND <= 8470) ~ "15. Health Care & Social Assistance",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 8560 & IND <= 8590) ~ "16. Arts, Entertainment, & Recreation",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 8660 & IND <= 8690) ~ "17. Accommodation & Food Services",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 8770 & IND <= 9290) ~ "18. Other Services (Except Public Admin)",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 9370 & IND <= 9590) ~ "19. Public Administration",
      (YEAR >= 2003)&(IND >= 9670 & IND <= 9870) ~ "20. Military",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 17  & IND <= 29)  ~ "01. Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing & Hunting",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 37  & IND <= 49)  ~ "02. Mining, Quarrying, & Oil/Gas Extraction",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 57  & IND <= 69)  ~ "03. Utilities",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND == 77)                ~ "04. Construction",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 107 & IND <= 399) ~ "05. Manufacturing",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 407 & IND <= 459) ~ "06. Wholesale Trade",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 467 & IND <= 579) ~ "07. Retail Trade",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 607 & IND <= 639) ~ "08. Transportation & Warehousing",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 647 & IND <= 679) ~ "09. Information",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 687 & IND <= 699) ~ "10. Finance & Insurance",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 707 & IND <= 719) ~ "11. Real Estate & Rental/Leasing",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 727 & IND <= 749) ~ "12. Professional, Scientific, & Tech Services",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 757 & IND <= 779) ~ "13. Administrative, Support, & Waste Mgmt",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 786 & IND <= 789) ~ "14. Educational Services",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 797 & IND <= 847) ~ "15. Health Care & Social Assistance",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 856 & IND <= 859) ~ "16. Arts, Entertainment, & Recreation",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 866 & IND <= 869) ~ "17. Accommodation & Food Services",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 877 & IND <= 929) ~ "18. Other Services (Except Public Admin)",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 937 & IND <= 959) ~ "19. Public Administration",
      (YEAR < 2003)&(IND >= 967 & IND <= 987) ~ "20. Military",
      TRUE ~ "21. Unclassified / Not in Labor Force"
    )) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, ind_sector) %>%
  summarise(
    workers = sum(PERWT, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # 2. Collect into local memory
  collect() %>%
  
  # 3. Local Calculation & Cleaning
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(pct_workers = workers / sum(workers) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Catch any missing sectors and label them
  mutate(ind_sector = replace_na(ind_sector, "21. Unclassified / Not in Labor Force"))
```

## Visualize change in industry sectors

```{r pr-workers-plot}
# Using facet_wrap to clearly view trends across 20+ sectors without overlap
ggplot(ind_sector_data, aes(x = YEAR, y = workers, color = ind_sector)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ ind_sector, ncol = 4) +
  important_years_lines +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold") # Shrink facet titles slightly to fit
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Puerto Rican Workers by Industry Sector",
    subtitle = "Estimated workers over time. Note: Y-axis scales vary by panel to show specific trends.",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Workers"
  )
```


```{r us-workers-plot}
# Using facet_wrap to clearly view trends across 20+ sectors without overlap
ggplot(ind_sector_data_us, aes(x = YEAR, y = workers, color = ind_sector)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ ind_sector, ncol = 4) +
  important_years_lines +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold") # Shrink facet titles slightly to fit
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Total US Workers by Industry Sector",
    subtitle = "Estimated workers over time. Note: Y-axis scales vary by panel to show specific trends.",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Workers"
  )
```


## Percentage point difference

```{r pr-pp-change}
# Calculate the percentage point shift from the earliest to latest available year
ind_change <- ind_sector_data %>%
  group_by(ind_sector) %>%
  arrange(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = first(YEAR),
    last_year = last(YEAR),
    first_share = first(pct_workers),
    last_share = last(pct_workers),
    pp_change = last_share - first_share,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pp_change))

# Display top growing and declining sectors
print(head(ind_change, 5))
print(tail(ind_change, 5))

```
```{r us-pp-change}
# Calculate the percentage point shift from the earliest to latest available year
ind_change_us <- ind_sector_data_us %>%
  group_by(ind_sector) %>%
  arrange(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = first(YEAR),
    last_year = last(YEAR),
    first_share = first(pct_workers),
    last_share = last(pct_workers),
    pp_change = last_share - first_share,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pp_change))

# Display top growing and declining sectors
print(head(ind_change_us, 5))
print(tail(ind_change_us, 5))

```

```{r pr-pp-change-visualization}
ggplot(ind_change, aes(x = reorder(ind_sector, pp_change), y = pp_change, fill = pp_change > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  my_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#d95f02", "TRUE" = "#1b9e77")) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Industry Composition among Puerto Rican Workers",
    subtitle = "Percentage-point change in workforce share between first and last year",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage Point Change"
  )
```

```{r total-pop-change-visualization}
ggplot(ind_change_us, aes(x = reorder(ind_sector, pp_change), y = pp_change, fill = pp_change > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  my_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#d95f02", "TRUE" = "#1b9e77")) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Industry Composition among Total Workers",
    subtitle = "Percentage-point change in workforce share between first and last year",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage Point Change"
  )
```

## Calculate index

```{r pr-index-calc}
# Calculate an index to see relative growth within each sector (Baseline Year = 100)
ind_index <- ind_sector_data %>%
  filter(ind_sector != "20. Military", ind_sector != "21. Unclassified / Not in Labor Force") %>%
  group_by(ind_sector) %>%
  arrange(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(
    index = workers / first(workers) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r us-index-calc}
# Calculate an index to see relative growth within each sector (Baseline Year = 100)
ind_index_us <- ind_sector_data_us %>%
  filter(ind_sector != "20. Military", ind_sector != "21. Unclassified / Not in Labor Force") %>%
  group_by(ind_sector) %>%
  arrange(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(
    index = workers / first(workers) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r pr-index-plot}
ggplot(ind_index, aes(x = YEAR, y = index, color = ind_sector)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ ind_sector, ncol = 4) +
  important_years_lines +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
  ) +
  # Adding a horizontal baseline reference line at index = 100
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Industry Employment Growth Index",
    subtitle = "First year = 100. Dashed line represents baseline.",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Index"
  )
```
```{r us-index-plot}
ggplot(ind_index_us, aes(x = YEAR, y = index, color = ind_sector)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ ind_sector, ncol = 4) +
  important_years_lines +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
  ) +
  # Adding a horizontal baseline reference line at index = 100
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Industry Employment Growth Index",
    subtitle = "First year = 100. Dashed line represents baseline.",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Index"
  )
```


## Puerto Rican Workers by Industry by Age

```{r}
acs_with_age <- data_acs %>%
  mutate(
    age_grp = case_when(
      AGE < 16 ~ "minor",
      AGE >= 16 & AGE <= 24 ~ "16 to 24",
      AGE >= 25 & AGE <= 54 ~ "25 to 54",
      AGE >= 55 ~ "55+"
    )
  )
```
